results.summary: This project is a promotional VGA display for the RISC-V Ottawa group, based on the standard VGA demo from vga-playground.com. It drives a TinyVGA PMOD with 2-bit-per-channel colour and shows three text messages that bounce around the frame. The design uses a font ROM and stream ROM to fit in a 1×1 tile, with overlapping sprites highlighted in a strobe colour. It is intended as a promotional screen for the RISC-V Ottawa group.

This project is a neural network accelerator that performs inference using a purely digital finite-state machine. It is designed to be integrated into any SPI or I²C memory controller, with all operations pipelined for efficiency. The design is intended for machine learning inference tasks and is notable for its compact implementation. It is not a general-purpose processor but a dedicated accelerator.

This project is a HEX-to-7-segment decoder that supports digits 0-9 and letters A, b, C, d, E, F. It includes blank, lamp-test, decimal-point, and active-low mode support. The design is intended for driving seven-segment displays and is likely used in educational or prototyping contexts. It is a simple combinational logic block.

This project is a subtractor and ALU design created using the Wokwi simulator. It is intended for educational purposes, demonstrating basic arithmetic and logic operations. The design includes logic gates and combinational logic. It is a simple digital circuit suitable for learning digital design.

This project is an adder and ALU design created using the Wokwi simulator. It is intended for educational purposes, demonstrating basic arithmetic and logic operations. The design includes logic gates and combinational logic. It is a simple digital circuit suitable for learning digital design.

This project is a power supply design that accepts a 5V power supply or USB power source. It is intended for use with external hardware such as push buttons, LEDs, and a breadboard for prototyping. The design likely provides regulated power for digital circuits. It is a simple power management application.

This project is a ROM and memory design that includes a cipher and error-correction functionality. It is controlled by a finite-state machine and is intended for instrumentation applications. The design likely stores data and performs encryption or error checking. It is a digital logic block with multiple functions.

This project is an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) using sigma-delta modulation. It includes a FIR filter for signal processing and is implemented on an FPGA. The design is intended for sensor interface applications and includes analog circuitry. It is a mixed-signal design that converts analog signals to digital.

This project is a BCD to 7-segment decoder with factory-test support. It is designed to drive seven-segment displays and includes a test mode for manufacturing. The design is a combinational logic block that converts binary-coded decimal to display segments. It is likely used in digital clocks or counters.

This project is a popcount (population count) circuit that counts the number of set bits in a binary input. It is a combinational logic block that can be used in various applications. The design is simple and efficient, likely implemented with logic gates. It is a basic digital circuit.
